responsibility: Defines MSP430-specific RTL predicates used by the machine description to validate operands beyond generic GCC classes. The predicates distinguish volatile memory forms, disallow unsupported post-increment destinations, recognize MSP430 comparison operators and constant-generator immediates, classify cheap operands for instruction-length modeling, and identify high-memory operands that require 430X handling. These predicates are consumed by msp430.md patterns and attributes to guide instruction matching and costing.
